summary: AUDIT-ONLY iteration for Iron Rabbit REPAIR #5 Phase 1. Reproduced the reported Tile Pack drag/drop DUPLICATION defect. HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED: dnd-kit's cascadedCollision (pointerWithin -> rectIntersection -> closestCenter at SortableTilesProvider.jsx L187) resolves over.id to a NEIGHBORING pack's tile/container when the pointer path enters/near an adjacent pack section (very common on mobile/touch where packs stack vertically). This makes targetPackId !== sourcePackId in handleDragEnd L119-128, triggering onCrossPackMove with default 'copy' mode (line 146, modifier=false on touch), which calls NotesApp.handleCrossPackMove (L1886-1946) and creates a new note with id: uuidv4() at L1917 — the DUPLICATE. No code changes made per instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: Same-pack tile drag on TOUCH/MOBILE produces an unintended duplicate in a NEIGHBORING pack. Root cause: dnd-kit cascadedCollision (L187) uses pointerWithin first, which greedily returns a PackB droppable when the finger path briefly overlaps PackB's rect. handleDragEnd then treats it as cross-pack COPY (L146) and NotesApp.handleCrossPackMove L1917 mints a new uuidv4 note. Reproduced deterministically on 390x844 (iPhone) viewport with PackA(4)+PackB(2): dragging a1 -> a4 (both in PackA) with a small lateral wobble produced 7 notes (was 6), toast 'Copied to "PackB" · Hold ⌘/Ctrl to move', new note id 18a24228-0210-4987-aebe-56ca4d7a6865 in PackB.

action_items: PHASE-2 FIX (Surgical): In SortableTilesProvider.handleDragEnd (L106-147), before dispatching onCrossPackMove, VERIFY that the pointer's actual coordinates at drop time are inside the target pack's container rect. If pointerWithin resolved to a neighboring pack but the source pack still contains the pointer, fall back to same-pack reorder. Alternatively: (a) narrow cascadedCollision to closestCenter only, or (b) require an explicit dwell-over-target for cross-pack decisions, or (c) if targetPackId !== sourcePackId but the drag started via a same-pack grip AND the pointer moved <N pixels beyond source pack's bottom edge, treat as same-pack reorder (source pack bias). The safest surgical change is: in SortableTilesProvider L119-146, when over resolves to a different pack, DOUBLE-CHECK by inspecting event.activatorEvent's final clientX/clientY against source pack's boundingClientRect and require the drop point to be OUTSIDE it before treating as cross-pack.

Consider: In NotesApp.handleCrossPackMove (L1886), add a defensive guard: if the src/dst pack difference was triggered from a very brief neighboring hover (e.g. detect if user's original grip target was in srcPack), require an explicit modifier or a longer hover threshold before copying. Not strictly necessary if SortableTilesProvider is fixed.
The intended cross-pack COPY behavior (dragging clearly into another pack) still works and is unchanged; only the accidental boundary trigger needs fixing.
critical_code_review_comments: SortableTilesProvider.jsx L187 cascadedCollision — pointerWithin is TOO greedy at pack boundaries. It will return any droppable whose rect contains the pointer, and on mobile where PackB sits immediately below PackA, small finger drift into PackB rect flips the target. Recommended: closestCenter-only, OR pointerWithin scoped to the source pack first, then cross-pack only if pointer clearly exits source rect.

SortableTilesProvider.jsx L146 — the fallback default 'copy' when no modifier is held is a DANGEROUS default for touch. On touch there is no way to hold Cmd/Ctrl, so a user attempting to reorder can NEVER cause a MOVE — every accidental cross-pack resolve becomes a COPY, silently cloning the note. The hello-pangea handler (NotesApp L1728) correctly detects touchDragRef.current to switch touch default to MOVE; SortableTilesProvider is missing this parity — it should also default to MOVE on touch (or better: reorder-only unless the user explicitly drops on an empty pack-container droppable).

NotesApp.handleCrossPackMove L1917 — uuidv4() creates a fresh id even for what the user perceives as an in-place drag. No confirmation, no undo confirmation dialog; only a toast with an Undo action that expires in 6s. Consider requiring an explicit gesture for cross-pack COPY on touch.

success_rate.frontend: Bug reproduced 1/1 on mobile touch simulation

seed_data_creation: Seeded IndexedDB (IronRabbit / notes store) at runtime via localforage CDN inside page.evaluate(): (a) 5 notes in TestPack, (b) PackA(6)+PackB(3), (c) mobile: PackA(4)+PackB(2). Settings seeded with view_mode='icon', sort_by='custom', tour_completed=true, theme_chosen=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: REPRODUCTION STEPS (mobile 390x844): 1) Seed IDB with PackA(4 tiles a1..a4) + PackB(2 tiles b1,b2), settings view_mode='icon' sort_by='custom'. 2) Load app, ensure Grid view + group-by-category. 3) Touch-drag a1's grip toward a4 with a tiny lateral wobble (~15px at 33% and 66% of the path) via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent. 4) On drop: expect a new uuidv4 note appears in PackB with title 'A1' (the copy), original A1 remains in PackA, toast 'Copied to PackB · Hold ⌘/Ctrl to move'. Desktop mouse tests (1400x1000) did NOT reproduce because horizontal PackA row keeps drags away from PackB below. Bug is mobile/touch-specific due to vertical single-column pack stacking. Phase-2 fix should scope cascadedCollision or add source-pack bias/pointer-rect verification. Do NOT retest by mouse-drag on desktop — will falsely appear fixed.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: dnd-kit's cascadedCollision at SortableTilesProvider.jsx L187 uses pointerWithin() as the primary collision detector. On mobile viewport where multiple pack sections stack vertically, a same-pack drag whose pointer path (even slightly) crosses the adjacent pack's boundingClientRect causes pointerWithin() to return a droppable belonging to the NEIGHBORING pack. handleDragEnd (L106-147) then computes targetPackId from over.id (L122-127), gets a different pack than sourcePackId (L119), skips the same-pack branch (L130-143), and invokes onCrossPackMove(...,'copy') at L146 (modifier=false because no modifier key on touch). NotesApp.handleCrossPackMove (L1886-1946) then executes L1911-1929: original note is left intact, a NEW note is built via '{...original, id: uuidv4(), category_path:[dstPack], category:dstPack, ...}' at L1915-1928, and persisted via StorageService.saveNote (L1929). Net effect: user sees an unintended duplicate in the neighboring pack, while their original tile remains in the source pack.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) Seed IndexedDB DB 'IronRabbit' store 'notes' with 4 notes in category 'PackA' (ids a1..a4) and 2 in 'PackB' (b1,b2), all with category_path=[category]. Seed settings with view_mode='icon', sort_by='custom', tour_completed=true. 2) Open app on 390x844 viewport. 3) Via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent: touchStart on [data-testid="note-tile-grip-a1"] center, touchMove past 6px activation, then 30 touchMove steps toward [data-testid="note-tile-a4"] center with ~15px lateral wobble at steps 10 and 20, then touchEnd. 4) Observe: toast 'Copied to "PackB" · Hold ⌘/Ctrl to move'; new tile 'A1' with a fresh uuidv4 id appears in PackB; original A1 remains in PackA. IDB now has 7 notes instead of 6.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Phase-2 (surgical) — In SortableTilesProvider.handleDragEnd (L119-146): after computing targetPackId, obtain the source pack's DOM rect (via a ref registered by PackSection's setNodeRef) and the pointer's clientX/clientY at drop from event.activatorEvent (or track via a mousemove/pointermove listener). If targetPackId !== sourcePackId AND the drop point lies INSIDE the source pack's rect, override and treat as same-pack reorder using closestCenter within the source SortableContext. Additionally, change the touch default at L146 from 'copy' to 'move' (parity with NotesApp.handleDragEnd L1728) so an unavoidable cross-pack resolve at least does not clone. Or replace cascadedCollision with closestCenter/closestCorners exclusively, since pointerWithin's greedy semantics is unsuitable when adjacent droppables share edges.
